name: strata
description: Generational handoff runner: executes a long coding task as a chain of fresh Claude Code processes that pass a validated, compacted handoff forward, with independent verification of completion and crash-safe state.
tagline: Every generation is a fresh context. Only a validated core sample crosses the boundary.
highlights: Each generation is its own `claude -p` process — context never accumulates.
Independent `--verify` commands overrule the agent's own completion claim.
Atomic state: a killed host resumes from the last validated handoff.
Stall detector, generation ceiling, turn cap and cost ceiling stop runaway loops.
quickstart:
cd skills/autonomous/strata && ./install.sh

strata start "Fix the repository so lint and build pass without weakening checks." \
  --verify "npm run lint" \
  --verify "npm run build" \
  --max-generations 20 \
  --max-budget-usd 3

permissions.filesystem: read-write within the target git repository
permissions.environment: none read by the runner itself

security.reviewed_by: Repository owner, 2026-08-13: live run against Claude Code 2.1.231, seven defects fixed before release.
